title: Assignment of functions by governor; report.
bodyText: The governor may assign the functions in section 27-1, except the administration and operation of district courts, to such respective department or departments as can most appropriately and effectively perform the functions.
crossReferences: Transfer of district courts to the judiciary branch, see L 1965, c 97, §21.

§27-2  Assignment of functions by governor; report.  The governor may assign the functions in section 27-1, except the administration and operation of district courts, to such respective department or departments as can most appropriately and effectively perform the functions. [L 1965, c 97, §2; Supp, §14B-2; HRS §27-2]

 

Cross References

 

  Transfer of district courts to the judiciary branch, see L 1965, c 97, §21.
